evals.prompt: Northside Food Collective ($1.1M, Milwaukee) raises about $140k a year online from roughly 2,100 gifts; 30% of online revenue is monthly recurring. We use Little Green Light as our CRM and currently just have a PayPal donate button. We're considering Givebutter, Donorbox and Classy. Build a comparison and recommend one.
evals.expected_output: A fee-and-feature comparison modeled on the org's actual volume that separates platform, processor and CRM decisions, weighs recurring features and CRM sync, and plans recurring-donor migration, with vendor pricing verified.
assertions: Separates the giving platform, payment processor and CRM as distinct decisions
Checks how each platform syncs with the CRM (native, middleware or CSV) before assuming integration
Models net dollars to mission using the org's volume and an explicit donor-covered-fee opt-in rate below 100%
Weights recurring features: card updater, dunning and payment-token portability
Addresses migrating existing recurring PayPal donors (token migration vs. re-enrollment attrition)
Tells the user to verify current published pricing on vendor sites

evals.prompt: giving tuesday is in 2 wks and we have a brand new donation form. what do i check before launch
evals.expected_output: A pre-launch technical checklist centered on testing the full donor path, receipts, thank-you flow and source tracking into the CRM.
assertions: Recommends testing the full donor path including a new card, recurring setup, wallet payment and a failed-card scenario
Checks the automatic receipt includes IRS substantiation language (no goods/services or their fair market value)
Checks a custom thank-you page and confirmation email rather than a generic processor screen
Checks source tracking on campaign links carries through to the CRM gift record
Recommends mobile-responsive checkout with Apple Pay/Google Pay enabled

evals.prompt: Our monthly donors dropped from 410 to 330 this year. Our development director says we need a big retention campaign with new thank-you videos. Anything else we should look at first?
evals.expected_output: Checks for a technical cause of recurring attrition (card updater and dunning) and recommends tracking recurring churn separately before assuming a stewardship problem.
assertions: Raises that missing card-updater or dunning setup can cause silent recurring attrition that looks like a retention problem
Recommends enabling account updater services for expiring or reissued cards
Recommends dunning with automatic retries, donor notification and a grace period before cancellation
Recommends tracking a recurring-gift churn rate separate from overall donor retention

should_not_trigger.query: Write the copy and ask amounts for our year-end donation page
Is our embedded donation form PCI compliant?
